intro: Peru has three regions: a desert coast, the high Andes and the Amazon rainforest, which covers about 60% of the country.

chapters.title: Coast, mountains and jungle
text: The coast is desert, kept dry by the cold Humboldt Current. The Andes include Huascarán, Peru's highest peak, and the Colca Canyon, one of the deepest in the world. Lake Titicaca, shared with Bolivia, is the highest navigable lake.
The Amazon River begins in the Peruvian Andes.

chapters.title: El Niño
text: The El Niño weather pattern, which affects climates worldwide, was first named by Peruvian fishermen.

keyTerms.meaning: A warming of Pacific waters that changes weather.
